[LTIM.2.3] The nanosecond unit of `now()` and `monotonic_ns()` is a
storage and arithmetic contract, not an accuracy guarantee. Effective
clock resolution is platform-bounded — a microsecond-class host yields
`Time`/`Duration` values whose low digits are zero — and a conforming
runtime may surface only the resolution its platform clock provides.
Authors must not infer event ordering from sub-microsecond differences
in time values; the stream `seq` is the ordering authority ([LFST.5.3]).
